name: RNEStackChart
description: Single stacked track rendered as a bar, semi-circle or arc: segments either overlap from a shared origin or run end to end, with an optional unfilled remainder for progress-style tracks

data.name: data
data.description: Segments stacked into one track, in draw order. Array of { label?: string, value: number, color?: string } or plain numbers. Example: [{ label: 'Employee', value: 700 }, { label: 'Employer', value: 480 }] or [700, 480]

view.name: view
view.description: Shape of the track. 'bar' = horizontal pill on a cartesian grid, 'semi-circle' = upper half circle (180°), 'arc' = gauge-style 270° arc. Default: 'bar'

layout.name: layout
layout.description: How segments share the track. 'overlap' = every segment starts at min and segments lie on top of one another (longest drawn first), 'stack' = each segment starts where the previous one ended. Default: 'overlap'

max.name: max
max.description: End of the scale. When omitted the segments fill the whole track: min + the longest value in 'overlap' layout, min + the sum of the values in 'stack' layout. Set a larger value to leave an unfilled remainder, as in a progress track.

interval.name: interval
interval.description: Distance between axis labels, in value units. Automatic when omitted.

trackColor.name: trackColor
trackColor.description: Color of the unfilled part of the track. Default: '#e8e8e899'

thickness.name: thickness
thickness.description: Thickness of the bar in pixels. 'bar' view only. Default: 24

innerRadius.name: innerRadius
innerRadius.description: Inner radius of the ring, e.g. '58%' or 60. 'semi-circle' / 'arc' views only. Default: '58%'

outerRadius.name: outerRadius
outerRadius.description: Outer radius of the ring, e.g. '82%' or 90. 'semi-circle' / 'arc' views only. Default: '82%'

edge.name: edge
edge.description: Rounded ('curve') or square ('flat') ends. The filled run and the unfilled track are capped separately, and joints between segments stay square either way. Default: 'curve'

startAngle.name: startAngle
startAngle.description: Angle (degrees) the scale starts at, overriding the view default. 0 = right (3 o'clock), 90 = top, 180 = left. 'semi-circle' / 'arc' views only.

endAngle.name: endAngle
endAngle.description: Angle (degrees) the scale ends at, overriding the view default. 'semi-circle' / 'arc' views only.

showAxisLabels.name: showAxisLabels
showAxisLabels.description: Whether to show the scale labels along the track. Default: true

axisLabelMargin.name: axisLabelMargin
axisLabelMargin.description: Distance between the track and its scale labels, in pixels. Negative values move the labels inside the ring on 'semi-circle' / 'arc'. Default: 8

showSegmentLabels.name: showSegmentLabels
showSegmentLabels.description: Whether to draw the value of each segment inside the segment. Default: false

segmentLabelFormatter.name: segmentLabelFormatter
segmentLabelFormatter.description: Formats the label drawn inside a segment. Implies Show Segment Labels. (value, label, index) => string

centerText.name: centerText
centerText.description: Text drawn at the center of the ring (e.g. main value). 'semi-circle' / 'arc' views only.

centerSubtext.name: centerSubtext
centerSubtext.description: Text drawn below Center Text (e.g. label or unit). 'semi-circle' / 'arc' views only.

showLegend.name: showLegend
showLegend.description: Whether to show the legend (segment labels). Default: true

legendPosition.name: legendPosition
legendPosition.description: Placement of the legend: 'top' | 'bottom' | 'left' | 'right'. Top and bottom use a horizontal legend with wrapping; left and right use a vertical legend. Default: 'bottom'

tooltip.name: tooltip
tooltip.description: Built-in React Native segment tooltip overlay when renderTooltip is omitted: card (default), compact, kpi, striped, or none to hide the overlay.

renderTooltip.name: renderTooltip
renderTooltip.description: Optional (params) => ReactNode for the RN tooltip body at the pointer. When set, replaces the layout chosen by tooltip. Params: label, value, percent (share of total), percentOfMax (share of the min…max scale), total, color, seriesIndex, dataIndex, pointerX and pointerY in chart pixel space.

width.name: width
width.description: Width of the chart in pixels.

height.name: height
height.description: Height of the chart in pixels.

theme.name: theme
theme.description: Partial theme override. Merged with default theme from ChartThemeContext.

colors.name: colors
colors.description: Colors for the chart segments. Overrides theme colors. Example: ['#3b82f6', '#10b981', '#f59e0b']

onSelect.name: onSelect
onSelect.description: Callback when the user selects (taps/clicks) a segment. Event: seriesIndex, dataIndex, label, value, percent.
